chunks: The day We shall roll up the heavens like a written scroll, We shall revert it (to nothing) as it was before We first created it. This is a promise incumbent on Us; We will certainly fulfil it.
ai.seo_question: What happens to the heavens on the Day of Resurrection according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the metaphor of rolling up the heavens 'like a scroll' (katay al-sijill) highlights the tangible, physical nature of the cosmic transformation, contrasting the finite created order with the infinite Divine. This verse underscores Allah's absolute power over time and space, affirming that the resurrection is not merely a spiritual concept but a concrete reality promised by the One who initiated creation with ease. It serves as a reminder of the inevitability of the Day of Judgment, where the records of deeds are presented and the universe itself is reconfigured.
